pages.text: The $(l:drone_systems/drone_dock)Drone Dock$(/l)'s sibling, for you. Step onto its pad and it $(l)charges everything you carry at once$(): the $(l:trinkets/energy_sphere)Energy Sphere$(/l) and the $(l:trinkets/pocket_drone)Pocket Drone$(/l) on your belt, and every item in your inventory that holds FE, from any mod.

$(li)Place the Human Dock.$(br)$(li)Place a $(l:basics/cyber_frame)Cyber Frame Block$(/l) $(l)on top$() of it.$(br)The frame hides and the arch rises behind the pad like a tripod's legs, a clamp snapping shut at each joint. A display slides out of its top showing the dock's charge.
pages.title: Building it

pages.text: It takes FE from cables, or from a $(l:energy_storage/battery_bank)Battery Bank$(/l) beside it (with that side of the bank set to Out).
pages.title: Powering it

pages.text: $(l)Step onto the pad.$() It charges, in this order:$(br)$(li)the Energy Sphere on your belt;$(br)$(li)the Pocket Drone on your belt;$(br)$(li)every FE item in your inventory, armor and offhand, spare Energy Spheres included.
pages.title: Using it

pages.text: It has no screen: its lights show it working. Several players on the pad are each charged.
$(li)$(l)Charges each player at up to$(): 4,000 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Stores$(): 500,000 FE$(br)$(li)$(l)Takes in up to$(): 8,000 FE/t
pages.title: Numbers
